title: Add MSAA and VSync as configurable EngineConfiguration properties that propagate to GpuBackbuffer
body:
- [x] Add `TargetFps = config.TargetFPS;` to the `GpuBackbuffer` constructor alongside the existing `VSync` and `MsaaSampleCount` seeds
- [x] Update `EngineConfiguration.TargetFPS` docs to note it also serves as the default for new instances
- [x] Make `RenderSurfaceHostRegistry` thread-safe: add `_lock`, lock `Register`/`Unregister`, expose `internal Snapshot()`
- [x] Update all three `EngineConfiguration` setters (`TargetFPS`, `VSync`, `MsaaSampleCount`) to use `RenderSurfaceHostRegistry.Snapshot()`
- [x] Clarify `GpuBackbuffer` class-level thread-affinity docs: `VSync`, `MsaaSampleCount`, and `TargetFps` are exempt from the GL-thread requirement (plain field writes, safe from any thread)
